sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the second level of inspection I2, to be performed 
on an annually bases (Y1) or after 200/500/1000 working hours, which comes first as indicated in the above title block. The first draft initiated by eng. Mostafa 
Abd_Alla Beni Suef East 220kv Substation and published at 27 
 Feb 2002
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,

Wear safety 
 equipment.
Ensure that the CB isolated completely and grounded on both sides

sections.text: Works to be Carried Out

The Compressor Off 
 (Figure 1)

items:
Disconnect 
 the delivery pipe and suction filter from the compressor head,

Remove the 
 4 cap fastening screws and remove the cap and valve block

Remove the 
 suction valve membrane

Remove the 
 4 cylinder body fastening nuts and remove the body.

Replace 
 the compression and oil scraper rings.

Reassemble 
 and replace the cylinder gasket, head and cap gasket, complete valve block

Tighten 
 nuts and screws to the torques given in figure 2
The circuit breaker in Off position,
Check the state and tightening of the accessible screws and nuts.
Check operation of the anticondensate resistances,

Inspect, clean and lubricate the control connecting rod assemblies of the
 position indicator and auxiliary commutators,

Compare closing and opening operating times with those recorded during
 initial testing,

If operating times are found to be outside the limits or the discrepancy
between the phases
exceeds 3 ms during opening and 5 ms during closing, the set of three complete closing and/or opening valves must be replaced,

Check the operation of the auxiliary contacts, 
 from the control cabinet terminal board in open and closed position, check the 
 continuity of the auxiliary circuits with respect to wiring diagram using 
 circuit testers.

Check the air consumption, for more details: Starting 
 from motor compressor cut-out pressure, check that when running the rated 
 cycle, no signals or locks intervene due to low pressure.

Check 
that the auxiliary cabling terminals are correctly tightened.

Check the correct operation of the 
auxiliary relays.

Check the operation of 
the anticondensate resistance at the control cabinet, using an ammeter clamp, 
check the resistance absorb current.

Check the circuit breaker in off 
position.
Read and record the pressure and density meter and record the pressure of the SF6 gas.

Check the tightening of the 
foundation bolts, of pole supporting structures using the torque wrench.

Check the state and correct 
tightening of all the accessible nuts and screws including connections to the 
areial lines.

Check the 
External finishes, if the finishes is 
lacking or damaged, clean and treat the damaged points, and touch up the painted surfaces with 
polyurethane-based paint and the hot galvanized surfaces with cold zinc.

Measure the humidity content in the SF6 gas, should 
 not exceed 250 ppm in the volume

Clean the insulators (frequency of this operation must 
 also take account of ambient conditions).
